updateNotes: New phone Home made for live TV: a channel plays the moment you open it, with Favourites, Sport and Recent channels, now and next, and the Sports Hub. Sports Hub with today's matches, live football scores and which of your channels shows each match; follow your teams. Watchlist for films and series. Reminders for big PPV events with the channels that show them. Teletext subtitles and a choice of subtitle size and colour. A clearer message when your provider refuses a channel (check your VPN). Many fixes.
